ops.body: Follow-up standalone finding (2026-09-23): Getaway refresh had a real Codex path defect at skills/refresh/SKILL.md because the shared gather.md read used CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT unconditionally. It now uses the native-first ${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}} resource path, preserving Claude behavior. A Node fixture launches a real Bash file check from an unrelated temporary project cwd with PLUGIN_ROOT set and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT absent. The focused test failed before the edit with the exact old path and then passed; the complete workflow suite passed 54 tests, git diff --check passed, and slop-cop ran on the changed skill with exit 0 while reporting only pre-existing prose findings.
